analogy.rationale: FAK (PTK2/PTK2B) is a cytoplasmic tyrosine kinase whose inhibition mainly affects adhesion/migration signaling, producing modest transcriptional changes in these adherent cell lines; SRC and other tyrosine kinase inhibitors share the closest downstream signaling overlap, while receptor tyrosine kinase and PI3K inhibitors are more distant.
